rca_b.conclusion: The live diagnosis text generally contains causal prose. A secondary generation-contract gap exists because the current schema and prompt do not require an explicit source-A -> relation -> source/value-B -> effect field or sentence.

rca_c.conclusion: The frozen V2 matcher produces confirmed false negatives for the observed paraphrases: exact alias spans, directional order, and same-clause matching do not cover the live wording.

rca_d.conclusion: Repair succeeds because the proposal stage receives validated RCA references plus real source snippets and emits concrete edits, while V2 scores only bounded diagnosis text against conjunctive lexical relation variants. A correct edit proves the action path, not that the diagnosis text satisfies the frozen semantic contract.
